svg.title: cobot-atlas: coverage by role and manipulation task
svg.desc: Panel a: record counts per role, split by category. Panel b: for eight manipulation tasks, the categories that supply objects, the number of records and items that the atlas does not yet provide.

g.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Source Sans 3', 'Latin Modern Math', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: COBOT-ATLAS · WHAT IT OFFERS ROBOTICS AND WHAT TO ADD
(a) Manifest records by role and category
Segments run from the largest category. Robots and platforms: robotics, vehicles; Industrial components: industrial; Tools and hardware: tools; Manipulation benchmarks:
manipulation, YCB-inspired, toys and games, building blocks, articulated; Everyday objects: household, food, miscellaneous, animals and figures, coins and small items, laboratory,
art supplies, sports equipment, medical, musical instruments, plants, packaging; Perception and calibration: fabric, textured objects, zone markers, calibration, deformable,
transparent objects, occluders, distractors; Scenes and primitives: primitives, environments.
(b) Robotics uses: what the atlas supplies and what to add
YCB-inspired groceries and tools, mugs, bottles, cans, fruit,
containers with separate lids and screw caps; bagged and
bolts, nuts, washers, gears, bearings, connectors, 2020
standard assembly task boards; cable harnesses with
power drill, wrenches, pliers, caliper, screwdrivers, multimeter,
tool changers and ISO 9409 flanges; vises, jigs and fixtures
sorting bins, crates, boxes, trays, baskets, a pallet, conveyor
standard totes (KLT, Euro boxes); cartons with barcode and
cabinets with open and closed doors, drawer units, hinges,
door handles, levers, knobs and handwheel valves;
transparent and frosted solids, cloth, towels, rope, sponges,
reflective metal parts in clutter; transparent containers
ArUco and ChArUco boards, checkerboards, a colour chart, a
reference sphere, zone markers, lidar units
AprilTag and QR fiducials; barcode labels; retroreflective
legged and wheeled robots, a forklift, human figures, shelves,
doors, elevator buttons, light switches and wall sockets;
carts on casters; helmets and high-visibility vests
Source: cobot-atlas manifest at revision 425eef2; task counts match categories and identifier prefixes, so one record can serve several tasks.
